name: brain
description: Skeleton monorepo for a self-hosted, provider-agnostic assistant runtime and assistant packs.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-skeleton.mjs && pnpm run build && node --test "dist/**/*.test.js" "packages/*/dist/**/*.test.js" "packages/config/*/dist/**/*.test.js" "packages/providers/*/dist/**/*.test.js" "entrypoints/*/dist/**/*.test.js" "apps/*/dist/**/*.test.js" && node dist/brainctl.js doctor --config examples/config/runtime.yaml --pack assistant-packs/core
